subject: Tier escalation & monthly commit orchestration for FastRetail
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@fastretail.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0000
Subject: Request: higher monthly commit for Nov — FastRetail storefront spikes

Hi Olga,

Quick note from our ops/engineering team: since migrating search to your hosted API our monthly token consumption has spiked unexpectedly during promo windows. We forecast another 35–50% uplift heading into holiday and we want to avoid throttles.

Can we discuss increasing our committed monthly usage for Nov–Feb and smoothing the rate limits (soft cap vs hard cap)? Procurement wants to understand the cadence for billing and whether we can layer burst pockets on top of a higher commit. Attached is our usage snapshot for Sep to help baseline.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Li
Head of Product, FastRetail
attachments: FastRetail_usage_snapshot_SEP2026.csv
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Sara Li <sara.li@fastretail.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: higher monthly commit for Nov — FastRetail storefront spikes

Hi Sara — thanks for the snapshot, looks clear.

High-level proposal:
- Move FastRetail from current 2.5M token commit to a 4.0M monthly commit for 2026-11 through 2027-02 (4 months).
- Soft cap at 110% of commit with automatic burst credits up to 130% (paid at the committed overage rate) to prevent immediate throttles.
- Apply a staged rate-limit smoothing window for promotional days (multi-region routing to reduce single-region saturation).

Next steps I propose: a 30-minute alignment call to confirm SLA windows and finalize MOU language. I'll pull Marissa (finance/billing) and Karthik (dedicated capacity/ops) into the thread to confirm pricing and activation lead times.

If that sounds reasonable I can circulate an MOU draft and an ops cutover checklist.

— Olga Petrov
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: higher monthly commit for Nov — FastRetail storefront spikes

Thanks Olga — looked at the usage file. Quick notes:
- Baseline trend supports a move to 4.0M commit; recommend we price the uplift at the existing tier discount (no incremental change to unit price) for the 4-month window as an upsell incentive.
- Breakpoint: if average monthly consumption exceeds 5.5M over any two-month rolling window, apply the next rate tier and trigger a review.
- Billing: pro-rate Nov activation; invoice monthly. Procurement typically accepts a single consolidated invoice; we can include burst charges as a separate line item.

I'll prepare an MOU draft with the pricing lines and a short ops SLA. Olga — if you want to offer a one-time onboarding credit to offset initial overages, confirm amount and I'll reflect it.

— Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 17:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: higher monthly commit for Nov — FastRetail storefront spikes

Quick ops read:
- Activation lead time: 4 business days for the routing and soft-cap rules to propagate across regions, 7 days if we need scheduled maintenance for capacity reshuffle.
- Burst pocket mechanics: we can provision a temporary burst pool scoped to FastRetail's tenant; engineering recommends a 72-hour cool-down to avoid sustained overuse.
- Monitoring: will add a dedicated dashboard; set alerts at 85% and 98% of commit.

Action items for internal ops:
1) Prepare routing config and canary schedule.
2) Create alert channels in console and invite FastRetail ops.
3) Prep MOU appendix describing burst pocket rules.

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Sara Li <sara.li@fastretail.com>, procurement@fastretail.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: higher monthly commit for Nov — FastRetail storefront spikes

Sara — good news: attached is the MOU draft reflecting a temporary commit increase to 4.0M/month (Nov–Feb), soft cap and a 130% burst pocket, pro-rated billing for Nov, and the billing credit we discussed (one-time $5,000 onboarding credit). Also included is the ops cutover checklist.

If you approve I can route this for signature (DocuSign link below). Once countersigned we'll initiate the routing and monitoring tasks; Karthik estimates activation within 4 business days.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/FFX-8742
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8742

Best,
Olga
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
attachments: MOU_FastRetail_tier-escalation_v1.1.pdf
